title: data/photo-exif.json
description: How each photograph was taken, for the frames whose originals kept their camera data, by frame number. Written by generate_photo_exif.py from a folder of the originals; the gallery draws the lightbox's exposure line and its figures from it. additionalProperties is false on every level on purpose: nothing else a file's metadata holds (a position, a serial number, an owner's name, the software, a date) may be published here.

n.description: The frame's number, as in photography-files.json.

camera.description: The camera, maker and model as one name: "Canon EOS 60D".

lens.description: The lens model: "EF-S 55-250mm f/4-5.6 IS STM".

focal.description: The focal length in millimetres, as marked on the lens.

shutter.description: The shutter speed in seconds, as a camera shows it: "1/400" for a fraction, "0.5" or "30" from 0.3 seconds up.
